text: 中国7月份氧化铝出口30万吨，同比增33%；1-7月累计氧化铝出口191万吨，同比增21.7%。 7月份未锻轧铝及铝材进口28万吨，同比降22%；1-7月累计未锻轧铝及铝材进口215万吨，同比降7.7%。 7月份钢材进口44万吨，同比降2.1%；1-7月累计钢材进口314万吨，同比降10.1%。 7月份铝矿砂及其精矿进口1,904万吨，同比降4.6%；1-7月累计铝矿砂及其精矿进口13,988万吨，同比增13.8%。
text_en: China's July alumina exports totaled 300,000 tons, up 33% year-on-year; cumulative January-July exports were 1.91 million tons, up 21.7%. July unwrought aluminum and aluminum product imports were 280,000 tons, down 22%; cumulative January-July imports were 2.15 million tons, down 7.7%. July steel imports were 440,000 tons, down 2.1%; cumulative January-July imports were 3.14 million tons, down 10.1%. July bauxite and concentrate imports were 19.04 million tons, down 4.6%; cumulative January-July imports were 139.88 million tons, up 13.8%.
